message:
Convert k8s/ from Kustomize to Helm

Per the org-wide rule "kustomize is forbidden" (2026-05-16).

Same pattern as auth#11:
  k8s/
    Chart.yaml         # leaf chart, no deps
    values.yaml        # image.repository + image.tag (sed-bumped by CI)
    templates/
      serviceaccount.yaml
      deployment.yaml  # image: `{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}`
      service.yaml
      certificate.yaml
      xlistenerset.yaml
      httproute.yaml

values.yaml seeded with the currently-running tag (f02f97a) so ArgoCD's
first re-render under Helm shows zero meaningful diff against the live
cluster.

build-and-deploy.yaml updates:
- Drops the flaky `Install kustomize` step
- Replaces `kustomize edit set image …` with sed on values.yaml
- Updates the git-commit step to track values.yaml

ArgoCD auto-detects Helm by Chart.yaml presence — the
k8s/apps/kill-me.yaml Application manifest in infra-bootstrap doesn't
need any changes; same `path: k8s` works.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

issue.body:
Mechanical kustomize → helm conversion. Same shape as [auth#11](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/pull/11) and [kill-me#33](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/33). `helm template <app> k8s/` renders cleanly with the currently-deployed tag, so ArgoCD should sync to a no-op diff on first render under Helm. CI bumps `values.yaml` via `sed` instead of installing the kustomize CLI.
